name: guidelinesapp
description: Guidelines of the Beta maṣāḥǝft project

comments.dependencies: Frontend vendor libraries served to the browser. The build.xml vendor target copies these from node_modules into resources/{js,css,fonts}/external (scripts/copy-vendor-libs.js).
comments.jquery: 3.7.1, the version BetMasWeb and the parser run (was 1.7.1 from shared-resources). Not 4.x: bootstrap 3.4.1's JS refuses jQuery >= 4. Only page.html's hljs call and bootstrap's navbar/dropdown use it.
comments.bootstrap: 3.4.1 (was 3.0.3 from shared-resources): same 3.x API, security fixes, the version BetMasWeb ships. Needed for the navbar collapse and dropdown.
comments.openseadragon: 2.1.0, the same version that was committed under resources/openseadragon.
comments.@highlightjs/cdn-assets: 11.12.0, the prebuilt browser bundle of highlight.js (the highlight.js npm package itself has no browser build). Replaces the committed custom 9.12.0 pack; the guidelines only highlight xml and json, both in the default bundle. The 9.x line is not published as cdn-assets.
